ai_model_run_metrics_chk.name: ai_model_run_metrics_chk
ai_model_run_metrics_chk.value: coalesce("ai_model_run"."input_tokens", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("ai_model_run"."output_tokens", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("ai_model_run"."cost_minor", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("ai_model_run"."latency_ms", 0) >= 0

divergence_case_options_chk.name: divergence_case_options_chk
divergence_case_options_chk.value: ("divergence_case_version"."answer_format" in ('single_choice', 'multiple_choice') and "divergence_case_version"."options" is not null) or ("divergence_case_version"."answer_format" not in ('single_choice', 'multiple_choice') and "divergence_case_version"."options" is null)

artifact_remediation_verification_chk.name: artifact_remediation_verification_chk
artifact_remediation_verification_chk.value: ("artifact_remediation"."verified_at" is null and "artifact_remediation"."verified_by_membership_id" is null) or ("artifact_remediation"."verified_at" is not null and "artifact_remediation"."verified_by_membership_id" is not null)

document_chunk_pages_chk.name: document_chunk_pages_chk
document_chunk_pages_chk.value: "document_chunk"."page_start" is null or ("document_chunk"."page_start" >= 0 and ("document_chunk"."page_end" is null or "document_chunk"."page_end" >= "document_chunk"."page_start"))

audit_event_actor_chk.name: audit_event_actor_chk
audit_event_actor_chk.value:
("audit_event"."actor_type" = 'membership' and "audit_event"."actor_membership_id" is not null and "audit_event"."service_account_id" is null and "audit_event"."support_operator_id" is null) or
      ("audit_event"."actor_type" = 'service_account' and "audit_event"."actor_membership_id" is null and "audit_event"."service_account_id" is not null and "audit_event"."support_operator_id" is null) or
      ("audit_event"."actor_type" = 'support_operator' and "audit_event"."actor_membership_id" is null and "audit_event"."service_account_id" is null and "audit_event"."support_operator_id" is not null) or
      ("audit_event"."actor_type" = 'system' and "audit_event"."actor_membership_id" is null and "audit_event"."service_account_id" is null and "audit_event"."support_operator_id" is null)

legal_hold_release_chk.name: legal_hold_release_chk
legal_hold_release_chk.value: ("legal_hold"."released_at" is null and "legal_hold"."released_by_membership_id" is null) or ("legal_hold"."released_at" is not null and "legal_hold"."released_by_membership_id" is not null and "legal_hold"."released_at" >= "legal_hold"."starts_at")

graph_node_exact_type_chk.name: graph_node_exact_type_chk
graph_node_exact_type_chk.value:
("graph_node"."node_type" = 'source_version' and "graph_node"."source_version_id" is not null and "graph_node"."artifact_version_id" is null and "graph_node"."claim_version_id" is null) or
      ("graph_node"."node_type" = 'artifact_version' and "graph_node"."source_version_id" is null and "graph_node"."artifact_version_id" is not null and "graph_node"."claim_version_id" is null) or
      ("graph_node"."node_type" = 'claim_version' and "graph_node"."source_version_id" is null and "graph_node"."artifact_version_id" is null and "graph_node"."claim_version_id" is not null)

membership_role_revocation_chk.name: membership_role_revocation_chk
membership_role_revocation_chk.value: ("membership_role"."revoked_at" is null and "membership_role"."revoked_by_membership_id" is null) or ("membership_role"."revoked_at" is not null and "membership_role"."revoked_by_membership_id" is not null)

probe_assignment_recheck_kind_chk.name: probe_assignment_recheck_kind_chk
probe_assignment_recheck_kind_chk.value: ("probe_assignment"."assignment_kind" = 'initial' and "probe_assignment"."recheck_assignment_id" is null) or ("probe_assignment"."assignment_kind" <> 'initial' and "probe_assignment"."recheck_assignment_id" is not null)

probe_response_payload_chk.name: probe_response_payload_chk
probe_response_payload_chk.value:
("probe_response"."answer_format" in ('single_choice', 'multiple_choice') and "probe_response"."selected_option_ids" is not null and "probe_response"."free_text_ciphertext" is null) or
      ("probe_response"."answer_format" = 'free_text' and "probe_response"."selected_option_ids" is null and "probe_response"."free_text_ciphertext" is not null)
